tools.name: check_grid_connection
tools.description:
Check nearest UK electricity Distribution Network Operator (DNO) grid
connection headroom for a location: generation/demand headroom (MW/MVA),
RAG status, voltage, and a combined BNG+grid siting signal. Covers all of
Great Britain (England/Scotland/Wales), not just England. Free, no key.

tools.name: check_planning_history
tools.description:
Find planning applications near a UK location, via UK PlanIt's public
aggregator (over 400 UK planning authorities). Free, no key. radius_km must be
between 0.1 and 5.0.

Defra statutory credit price; local factors (flood zone, SSSI, Green Belt,
Ancient Woodlan
